natural.label: Natural Language
natural.title: Ask in Plain Words

features.title: From Monitoring to Root Cause
features.subtitle: A three-layer diagnosis system — from continuous sensing to AI-powered reasoning.

health.title: Full-Spectrum Health Check
health.desc: 20+ checks across 7 dimensions — instance, storage, sessions, memory, logs, backup, and security. Get a complete picture in one command.

dbtop.title: Real-Time Performance Dashboard
dbtop.desc: Like Linux top for databases. 1-second refresh showing SGA, PGA, TPS, QPS, wait events, and active sessions live.

rule.title: 273-Rule Decision Engine
rule.desc: Millisecond-level deterministic diagnosis. Works offline — no LLM, no network, no API cost. Your safety net when AI is unavailable.

llm.title: AI-Powered Deep Diagnosis
llm.desc: Multi-round LLM reasoning with function calling. Automatically collects evidence, correlates symptoms, and delivers executable fix SQL — not vague suggestions.

sentinel.title: 24/7 Anomaly Detection
sentinel.desc: Background probe monitoring 48 metrics with adaptive 3-sigma baselines. Detects anomalies before they become outages.
